_about: Public-domain William Burt Pope (1822-1903, Wesleyan Methodist, tutor at Didsbury College) for the Word Hoard: A Compendium of Christian Theology (2nd ed., 3 vols, London: Wesleyan Conference Office), The Person of Christ (Fernley Lecture, 2nd ed., 1875), The Prayers of St. Paul (1876), A Higher Catechism of Theology (1883) and The Inward Witness (1885), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
